title: The same syn periplanar norbornane E2 as the reference fixture, but its conformational_justification annotation is one meaningless character

expect.note: Adversary pass, Phase 1, attack surface 2. periplanarity.ts's own docstring draws the line: 'This check never decides whether the stated conformational reason is a good one... It also does not read the conformational justification for sense. Whether a bicyclo[2.2.1] cage genuinely cannot reach 180 degrees is chemistry a human wrote down and a human reviews.' This fixture is that admission made concrete rather than left as prose. It is structurally identical to good-e2-syn-periplanar-in-a-conformationally-locked-norbornane, same substrate, same declared torsion at 3 degrees, same real syn periplanar elimination, correct arrows, correct totals. The only change is the conformational_justification annotation: value "z" and justification "z", one meaningless character each, non empty by the letter of trim() === "" and saying nothing about a cage, a dihedral, or why anti is unreachable. angleViolations calls requiredAnnotationViolations with kind conformational_justification, which checks found.length === 1 and both strings non empty after trim, and stops there. A student problem authored this way would flag a syn E2 as requiring a defence and then accept a defence that defends nothing. CLOSED IN PART, Phase 1 builder pass two, and the part that is not closed is stated here rather than left to be discovered. The new rule is grounding, not length: the value and justification together must name at least one atom id or species id that is really in this state. The honest annotation on good-e2-syn-periplanar-in-a-conformationally-locked-norbornane names C1, C2, C3, C4 and C7 while explaining what the bridge fixes, and passes. The value z and justification z name nothing, and fail. A minimum character count was considered and rejected, because two arbitrary words defeat it while making a report read as though content were being checked. WHAT IS STILL NOT CHECKED, AND IS A HUMAN GATE: whether the sentence is TRUE. An annotation reading only C3 would now pass, and whether a bicyclo[2.2.1] cage genuinely cannot reach 180 degrees is chemistry a person reads. This rule is a floor under that review, never a substitute for it.

declaredTorsions.justification: The bicyclo[2.2.1]heptane cage fixes the C2 to C3 torsion at a few degrees off eclipsed, the same real geometric claim as good-e2-syn-periplanar-in-a-conformationally-locked-norbornane, kept honest here even though the annotation below is not.
